narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -4.55 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 885.52-917.21 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 934.95; the first objective pays 2.07R at 891.40.
